observations.body: Jesus joins knowing the sheep, one flock, the Father’s love, voluntary self-giving, authority to lay life down, and authority to take it again.
observations.label: The shepherd lays down his life and speaks of taking it again

observations.body: The passage presents Laying down and taking again as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Laying down and taking again

observations.body: The passage places The Father’s command beside Laying down and taking again.
observations.label: The Father’s command

payload.posture: Read John 10:14–18 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus joins knowing the sheep, one flock, the Father’s love, voluntary self-giving, authority to lay life down, and authority to take it again. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
payload.title: The shepherd lays down his life and speaks of taking it again
